title: Two moves generate all 24 rotations of a cube
lede: Turn the numbered cube with A, a quarter turn about the vertical axis, and B, a third of a turn about the body diagonal. The counter tracks every distinct orientation the cube has had.
notice: Starting from just A and B, the number of distinct orientations keeps growing and then stops at 24. No further move can add a new one.
The count is exact: the cube's orientation is stored as a rotation matrix, and two orientations are the same only when their matrices are equal.
Four A turns, or three B turns, bring the cube back to where it started.
hint: Press A and B in any order, or try Random 12 moves. Drag to look around.
